Package model

Class User

java.lang.Object
model.User
Direct Known Subclasses:
Administrator, Member, Receptionist, Trainer
public abstract class User extends Object
Abstract base class representing any authenticated actor in the system (Administrator, Trainer, Receptionist, or Member), matching the <<Abstract>> User class in the SRS class diagram (Figure 6).

The system uses a single users table (single-table inheritance) to store authentication data shared by every role: id, name, email and password hash. Role-specific attributes live in dedicated tables/classes (e.g. Trainer.getSpecialization()).
